name: GIFT CERTIFICATE
description: Do you need to hint at someone that you want as a gift – shopping? Colleagues at work it is more convenient to throw off money on a gift, but you do not want to give money in an envelope? Has chosen a dress, but to explain to the young man, in which complex color – ultramarine or marsala you want it – it is not possible? Do you have a girlfriend that you want to push to a new image, give her attention to herself and give her a chance to devote time to herself, which she, of course, deserves, but does not want \ can afford it herself? For all of these and thousands of other cases – we now have a certificate. We draw on it absolutely any amount – at will and the possibilities of the donor. The term of its validity is six months. It applies to all things that are available. It does not matter what season, sejl and novelties – on everything. Exchange it for a thing you can in the showroom or on the market or in the online-new mail mode. If at the moment there is no desired color-size – you can look a little later. Generally. We will do our best to make the girl gifted with our gift certificate happy. If it’s a beginner who does not know much about us – we’ll get acquainted and help her with a choice.

name: Convertible Bag
description: Unisex convertible bag made of satin-finish technical fabric with light insulation. Truly spacious, and exceptionally comfortable. It can be reconfigured and worn in multiple ways: as a crossbody bag, an oversized shopper, or even as a backpack. Available in water-repellent technical fabric or cotton — your choice. For some, it will become an everyday essential, for others — the perfect travel companion. Either way, it’s guaranteed to be one of the most comfortable bags you’ll own. The straps can be adjusted and reattached in more than five different ways. Wide handles don’t twist or dig into your shoulders. Durable Fastex buckles are easy to release, allowing you to quickly unclip the bag without having to lift it over your head — especially convenient when it’s heavy. Built to withstand substantial weight. Features a spacious outer pocket for quick access to frequently used essentials. Fully lined, with two zippers: one for the main compartment and another for the external pocket. Composition: 100% polyester
